testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, link, tab, modal trigger, and data item MUST have explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or bland corporate SaaS styling. This is an electrifying, soulful campus music collective.
Ensure dark theme looks rich and velvety using #0B0C10 base with #12141C card surfaces and #F97316 / #EF4444 / #A855F7 accent glows.
Do not use transparent background in header or modal overlays without backdrop-blur and semi-opaque background.
Keep all copy and contact references intact: Chanakya, Siddharth, Jam Room #2, sidchan901@gmail.com, and semester roadmap (Meetup, Jams, Open Mic, Concert).
Include Google OAuth login with Google client id integration and graceful fallback for dev testing.
Implement the 3-step OTP password reset flow cleanly with sonner toast notifications and test OTP visibility.
